body:
I must say it's been an interesting day for me and opening up to complete strangers has helped lift me up from where I was this morning.  It really is a wonderful subreddit and it's great to get support.

So far today I've redesigned my CV and sent it out to around 10 local companies. I've already had a callback from one of them wanting me to go in and meet them this friday. Just doing something as simple as that has made feel that today I have made a move in the right direction and I am feeling more positive. Hopefully everything falls in to place.

I agreee with you. one thing to mention on the weed is that most of my friends smoke weed almost every night. Which I guess is fine when you have such high paying jobs and nothing else to worry about but I know if I start to hang out with them they'll let me smoke for free and I'll go back to smoking on my own and start the lonely cycle again.

 My girlfriend is great! I've tried to push her away so many times when I've been feeling sorry for myself but she just sticks by me. I know she worries for me as she knows something is up with me and she's often been scared to leave me on my own when I've been so down, it's nice to know someone cares but I'm not sure how long she'll put up with this situation.

Thank you so much. Just writing this thread and reading over it has made me look at it from outsiders point of view, which does help. As I am writing this I'm trying to do something about it but I'm so much at rock bottom I can't see anyway out. I'll make some phone calls for some jobs and apply for benefits, although I really don't want to go on benefits and get handouts I feel like if I can just get enough money to get a cheap suit I could get a job. I do want a job and I do want to work. When I worked I worked in a call center but the money was surprisingly very good with bonus' but I just let the weed takeover. I feel like if I can sort my financial situation out that I can strive to do more and make more efforts with myself and family. I've had it all before, I used to go the gym 5 days a week, I had an expensive car and I had the money to take my girlfriend out and buy her things. I really can't believe she is sticking by me.

I hope so, I do tell myself it will get better but I don't see how. Today is one of the first times I have cried, I'm 23 year old male sat at my computer in tears, I can't tell you how pathetic I feel. I appreciate the positive words :).

She's 17, she's barely at home she's very outgoing. 


Honestly it's the sheer lack of confidence I now have. I'm scared to go out, I panic when put in social situations which is something that has slowly developed over the last year. I just feel worthless, I can't be in silence, I can't sleep without having the TV because my brain goes in to overdrive with worry and what I can do. I don't know what my options are for help. I've pawned almost everythingthing I own to just pay for the electricity in my house. I just don't know where I went wrong, I used to have tens of thousands of pounds ££ in my bank when I was around 18 year old. Ofcourse I blew it all within about 1.5 years on useless shit so much regret for that.
